name: Spitball
author: supercleanse
description: Records, transcribes and summarizes your calls. Spitball notices when Zoom, Meet, Slack, Teams or another call app starts using your mic, shows a record button in the bar, and saves audio, a two-sided transcript (Deepgram) and a summary (any OpenAI-compatible model, local Ollama by default) for every call.

barWidget.description: Record button that appears when a call starts: amber when a call is detected, red with a timer while recording. Right-click for the full menu.
